title: cleyera japonica f. tricolor

This plant is known for its vibrant tricolored leaves, which are a combination of green, white, and pink, and is prized for its ornamental value. The health benefits of Cleyera japonica f. tricolor include its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant.
